subject: general
question: Which diseases result from a deficiency of Vitamin B due to its insufficient intake?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Beri Beri**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Beri Beri** is a disease caused by a** deficiency of Vitamin B1** (thiamine).
 
• This condition can affect the **cardiovascular system** (wet beriberi) or the **nervous system** (dry beriberi).
 
• Symptoms of beriberi include weakness, pain in the limbs, shortness of breath, and swollen feet or legs.
 
• Vitamin B1 is essential for **glucose metabolism**, and its deficiency can lead to serious health issues.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Vitamin B1 is found in foods such as whole grains, legumes, nuts, and seeds.
 
• Thiamine supplements can be used to treat and prevent beriberi, especially in populations with a high risk of deficiency.
 
• Other diseases caused by Vitamin B deficiencies include **pellagra **(caused by niacin deficiency) and **pernicious anemia **(caused by vitamin B12 deficiency).
 
• A balanced diet rich in various nutrients is crucial for preventing vitamin deficiencies and maintaining overall health.
